m: Get a big pot of well-salted water boiling and cook the pasta. Keep a mug of the cooking water.
Meanwhile, sizzle the sliced garlic and fresh chilli in a generous glug of oil over medium heat for 1 minute. Don't let the garlic brown.
Add the halved tomatoes and cook 2 minutes until they start to burst.
Turn the heat up, add the prawns and cook 1 to 2 minutes a side until just pink.
Add the drained pasta, butter, lemon zest and juice and a splash of pasta water. Toss hard for a minute until glossy.
Finish with parsley and chilli flakes and serve straight away.
l: Reheat gently with a splash of water. Prawns are best eaten within a day.
g: GF pasta in a separate pot, tossed in its own pan with a share of the prawns.
